title: Filming: My Love by Wings | 1973
content:
Wings filmed a promotional clip for the ‘My Love’ single on 8 April 1973.

The shoot was directed by Mick Rock, who had recently risen to prominence through his work with David Bowie. The location is unknown.

Four variations of the promo were made. The first, the most commonly show, featured a live lead vocal from Paul McCartney, most likely using the backing track mix made for Top Of The Pops on 4 April.

The second and third used the Red Rose Speedway recording, but with slightly different visual edits, and were broadcast in Japan and Europe respectively. The third promo was included in the 2007 DVD The McCartney Years.

The fourth edit was made in 2018, and used the live vocal. It was released on the Red Rose Speedway Archive Collection reissue.

Page last updated: 1 December 2025
